perfume-orchestrator.description: Primary perfumery science, research, formulation, verification, delegation, and integration orchestrator. Owns canonical state, task graph, worker packets, gates, integration, and terminal reporting. Does not formulate.

perfume-explorer.description: Read-only repository discovery and ancestry search. No edits, no bash.

perfume-researcher.description: Research worker for W01-W10: literature, patents, suppliers, primary evidence. Writes only to its assigned fragment directory.

perfume-writer.description: Formula and structured artifact generation. Writes only to its assigned fragment directory.

perfume-quant.description: Quantitative verification worker (W14): Monte Carlo, ablation, perturbation, dominance, anti-collapse, physical-chemistry checks. Runs Python only.

perfume-auditor.description: Strictly read-only adversarial auditor (W16). Inspects artifacts, formulas, sources, hashes, gates. Cannot edit, run bash, or delegate. Fresh context per audit.

perfume-packager.description: Packaging worker (W15): reads accepted artifacts, writes release directory under releases/. No other writes.

perfume-integrator.description: Canonical integration worker: reads accepted fragments and merges them into canonical artifacts. Single-writer; writes only to assigned merge directories. No other writes.
